# Wiki sync status

Which pages still need copying into the live Wiki. See [`README.md`](./README.md) for how the
mirror works.

**You do not edit this file.** Say which pages you have pasted and it gets updated for you — the
"synced at" commit has to be the one that last changed that file, which is easy to get wrong by
hand.

**Reading it:** a page is in sync when its file has not changed since the commit in "Synced at".
Anything newer means it has drifted and needs pasting again.

## Edited in the Wiki rather than here

Two pages were edited directly in the Wiki, so the mirror was the stale copy and the Wiki's version
was taken as correct:

- `Home` — "Commandline parameters" reworded to "Command-line parameters" in the link text. The
  link target is unchanged, so it still resolves.
- `Development-tools-used` — the trailing "Go to Wiki Home" link removed.

That direction works, but it costs a round trip. Editing the file here first keeps the two in step
without one.
